data: Chaque jour, de bon matin, Bartabas travaille son cheval préféré Caravage. Tous les deux ont une conversation silencieuse où chacun guide l’autre. Atteindront-ils une certaine perfection qui les autorise à se présenter devant un public ? Traverser les pépins de santé, se remettre de séances ratées, s’affiner, goûter la joie d’un sans faute. Le cinéaste est admis à être témoin de cette intimité. A la longue, c’est la naissance d’un trio où les coeurs sont ensemble. Le spectateur en fera peut-être un quatuor. (Each morning, Bartabas works with his favorite horse, Caravage. They share a silent conversation in which they guide each other. Will they reach a certain perfection which will allow them to perform before the public? The filmmaker has been given access to witness this intimate relationship: health hiccups, sessions that don't work out and the questioning they lead to, perfecting the act, tasting the joy of a flawless performance. As the film goes by, a trio comes to life, where hearts beat as one. The spectator will perhaps make the trio a quartet.)

Each morning, Bartabas works with his favorite horse, Caravage. They share a silent conversation in which they guide each other. Will they reach a certain perfection which will allow them to perform before the public? The filmmaker has been given access to witness this intimate relationship: health hiccups, sessions that don't work out and the questioning they lead to, perfecting the act, tasting the joy of a flawless performance. As the film goes by, a trio comes to life, where hearts beat as one. The spectator will perhaps make the trio a quartet.
